PM-JAY.name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana

Q-2215.question: My family earns ₹2.4 lakh a year. Are we eligible for the ₹5 lakh cover?

Q-2214.question: What documents do I need to claim the maternity benefit instalments?

Q-2213.question: My child missed the last polio drop. Where is the nearest catch-up camp?
Q-2213.reply: A catch-up camp is scheduled at Palia School this Saturday, 10 AM – 2 PM. Please carry the child’s vaccination card.

Q-2212.question: Can I get a free blood sugar test under this scheme at my PHC?
Q-2212.reply: Yes. Free screening is available every Thursday at your nearest PHC under NPCDCS. Carry your Aadhaar card.

Q-2211.question: Does the school health check-up cover hearing and vision screening?

Q-2210.question: How do I get a new e-card if my old one was lost?
Q-2210.reply: Please visit your nearest empanelled hospital or CSC with Aadhaar to re-issue your e-card free of cost.
